sections.name: Part A: General Knowledge / Current Affairs
Part D: Computer Fundamentals, MS Excel, MS Word, Communication, Internet

subjects.name: General Knowledge, Current Affairs & Delhi Special (सामान्य ज्ञान, समसामयिकी एवं दिल्ली अध्ययन)
domains: History of India, Indian Freedom Struggle & Delhi Historical Monuments (Red Fort, Qutub Minar, Humayun Tomb, India Gate)
Culture, Art, Classical & Folk Dances, Fairs and Festivals of India
Geography of India and World Geography, Rivers, Soils, Climate, National Parks
Indian Economy, Economic Planning, Five Year Plans, Union Budget, NITI Aayog, Banking & GST
Indian Constitution & Polity: Preamble, Fundamental Rights, DPSP, Parliament, President, Supreme Court, NCT of Delhi Governance (Article 239AA)
Scientific Research, Space Missions (ISRO), Nuclear Energy, Everyday Physics, Chemistry & Biology
Delhi Police Administration: Motto ('Shanti, Seva, Nyaya'), Police Station Architecture, Special Cell, Traffic Police, Cyber Crime Cell
National & International Current Affairs, Summits, G20, Sports, Honors and Awards

subjects.name: Reasoning Ability & Mental Aptitude (तर्कशक्ति एवं मानसिक क्षमता)
domains: Analogies & Semantic Similarities (Verbal and Figural)
Spatial Orientation & Spatial Visualization
Visual Memory, Discrimination & Observation
Relationship Concepts & Blood Relations
Arithmetical Reasoning & Figural Classification
Arithmetic Number Series, Letter Series & Alpha-Numeric Patterns
Non-Verbal Series, Paper Folding, Paper Cutting & Embedded Figures
Coding-Decoding (Letter Shift, Number Substitution, Matrix)
Statement and Assumptions, Logical Venn Diagrams & Syllogisms

subjects.name: Numerical Ability & Quantitative Aptitude (संख्यात्मक योग्यता)
domains: Number Systems, Computation of Whole Numbers, Divisibility Rules & Remainder Theorem
Decimals, Fractions, Recurring Decimals, LCM & HCF
Simplification & BODMAS Operations
Percentages & Applications in Commercial Mathematics
Ratio & Proportion, Direct & Inverse Variations, Partnership
Averages, Weighted Averages & Age Problems
Simple Interest & Compound Interest (Installments)
Profit and Loss, Marked Price & Successive Discounts
Time and Work, Efficiency, Wages, Pipes and Cisterns
Time and Distance, Relative Speed, Train Problems, Boats & Streams
Mensuration 2D (Triangles, Rectangles, Circles) & 3D (Cylinder, Cone, Sphere, Cube, Cuboid)

subjects.name: Computer Fundamentals, MS Office & Internet (कंप्यूटर ज्ञान, एमएस वर्ड, एक्सेल एवं इंटरनेट)
domains: Elements of Word Processing: Basics of MS Word, Opening, Saving & Closing Documents, Text Creation, Font Formatting, Paragraph Alignment
MS Excel: Spreadsheets, Rows & Columns, Cell Referencing, Functions (SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MAX, MIN, IF) & Formulas
Communication & Email: Basics of E-mail, CC, BCC, Attachments, Inbox, Sent, Spam, Email Protocols (SMTP, POP3, IMAP)
Internet & Web Technologies: World Wide Web (WWW), URL Structure, HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, DNS, IP Addresses
Web Browsers & Navigation: Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Search Engines (Google, Bing), Cookies, Cache, Bookmarks
Cyber Security Basics: Antivirus, Firewalls, Phishing, Malware, Ransomware, Strong Passwords, OTP Authentication
